transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... the regular clinic sent me. They've been getting on me about... I guess how little I've been eating. 

I don't really get it. Most days I just grab a coffee before my shift at the warehouse... maybe a yogurt or just a few bites of something after GED class. Sitting down for a real meal just... it kind of throws off everything I'm trying to keep in line. So... yeah. That's why they told me to come.
Do you enjoy eating when you do have a chance to sit down for a meal?
Um... I don't know. Not really. I don't really think about it like that. It's just... food, I guess. I don't really focus on enjoying it.
Do you ever think about your weight or body shape when you're deciding whether or not to eat?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. Like... if there's fried food in the break room at work, or... I don't know, a big plate of something at a church thing. 

I just... if I eat stuff like that, I get scared it's going to show on me right away. So... yeah, I'll keep thinking about it. And then I usually want to check the scale after. Just to make sure.
Do you think you would eat more if you weren't worried about gaining weight?
I don't know... maybe? I try not to think about it like that. It's just... I just don't eat that much. I don't know what I'd do if I wasn't worried about it.
Have you lost a lot of weight recently?

Um... I guess. My work pants are pretty loose lately. And... people keep saying I look too thin. But... I don't know. When I see the number go down, it just feels like I'm finally getting somewhere. I don't really see why I should be pushed to put it back on.
Is avoiding weight gain the main reason you restrict your food intake?
Um... yeah, I guess. Like I was saying before... I just get really scared that if I eat that kind of stuff, it's gonna show on my body right away. So... yeah, that's mostly why.
Do you think you are currently at a healthy weight?

Um... I think I'm fine. I know people from church have been worrying... and doctors... but I honestly think everyone is just making a bigger deal out of it than it is. I mean... I'm still going to work every day. I'm doing my classes. I'm keeping up with my life just fine. So... yeah. I don't really see the problem.
Do you often think about the possibility of gaining weight?

Um... yeah. Like I said before about it showing on me... if I eat something like, I don't know, fried food from the break room at work, or a big plate at church... I just get really scared. I'll just keep thinking about it... and then I usually want to go check the scale. So... yeah. I guess I think about it a lot.
Is the fear of gaining weight the main thing that drives you to restrict your food intake?

Um... yeah, I think so. Like I was just saying... it's just that fear. If I eat something heavy, like... I don't know, those fried snacks they leave in the break room... or if I have a big plate at a church dinner... I just get so scared it's going to show on me immediately. I can't stop thinking about it until I check the scale. So... yeah, I guess that fear is the main reason I try to avoid it.
Have you had any significant medical tests, like blood work, recently that showed you were underweight or malnourished?
Um... no. I haven't really been to a doctor for anything like that. I don't get blood work done. So... no.
Do you think you look too thin when you see yourself in the mirror?

Um... no. Not really. I mean... when I look in the mirror, like before I go to work or... or if I'm getting ready for softball... I still see things that aren't right. My stomach and my thighs... they just look bigger than they should be. And... I don't know, depending on how they look, it kind of just decides if I'm having a good day or if I'm... failing. So, no. I don't think I look too thin.
Is the fear of gaining weight the only reason you restrict your food intake?
Um... I don't know. I guess so. I just... I don't want to get bigger. That's pretty much all it is.
Do you think your weight or body shape is different from how others see it?
Um... I don't really know. People don't really say much to me about it. I just... I see what I see.
Do you think your weight or body shape is the same as how others see it?
I... I guess I just answered that. I don't really know how other people see me. I just know what I see.
Do you think you would look fat even if you gained a small amount of weight?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if I eat something, maybe like fried food someone left in the break room at work, or... a big plate at church... I just get scared it's gonna show on me right away. I just... I'll keep thinking about it and just want to check the scale.
Have you lost weight because you were afraid of gaining weight?

I mean... yeah. Like I just said, I get really scared about it showing on me right away if I eat that stuff in the break room or at church. So... I guess that's why I lost weight. I just try not to eat it so the scale doesn't go up.
Do you think your body shape or weight is normal, even when others tell you that you are too thin?

I mean... I know you guys are worried. And some people at church have said things. But... I don't know. I think everyone's just making a big deal out of nothing. I'm still going to work every day. I'm doing my classes. I'm fine.
Do you think your body shape or weight is the way you see it in the mirror, even if others see it differently?

I don't know... I mean, when I look in the mirror, like before my classes or if I'm getting ready for softball... my stomach and my thighs just look bigger than they should. And... I don't know, seeing that just kind of decides how my day goes. Like if I'm doing good or if I'm just failing at it.
Do you think your body shape is normal when you look in the mirror?
I don't know... I mean, I'm not really sure what normal is even supposed to look like. I just... I just see what I see.
